name: Edge Eloquent Source
subtitle: Official source repository for Edge Eloquent on-device dictation
description: The official Feather and AltStore-compatible repository for Edge Eloquent. Distributes standalone signed or sign-ready IPAs of Edge Eloquent, powered by Google AI Edge runtime for private on-device dictation.

apps.name: Edge Eloquent
apps.subtitle: Private on-device dictation powered by Google AI Edge
apps.localizedDescription: Private iOS dictation powered by the official Google AI Edge LiteRT-LM runtime and iOS-validated Gemma 3n models. Model artifacts are downloaded on demand and verified with SHA-256. Optional cloud text enhancement and web search are disabled by default. Audio never leaves the device.
apps.versionDescription: Official LiteRT-LM 0.16.1 runtime, on-device Gemma 3n dictation, local cleaner, and optional Cloudflare text enhancer. Model weights are not bundled.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required for real-time speech-to-text dictation directly on your device.
